title: LILYGO T-Dongle-C5 An ESP32-C5 USB dongle with microSD card slot, optional 0.96-inch OLED
summary: LILYGO T-Dongle-C5 is an ESP32-C5 dual-band WiFi 6, BLE, and 802.15.4 USB dongle that builds upon the earlier ESP32-S3-based T-Dongle-S3 board. The new board still features an optional 0.96-inch color display, a microSD card slot, and a USB-A male port.
